facts.fact: First get a One Time Registration (OTR) number on NSP: OTR is mandatory to get scholarships and is a unique number for the student's entire academic career
facts.quote: One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory to avail scholarships. It is a unique number allotted to the candidate for the entire academic career and can be generated through National Scholarship Portal OTR Registration .

facts.fact: The OTR number is issued on the basis of the student's Aadhaar or Aadhaar Enrolment ID (EID)
facts.quote: One Time Registration (OTR) is a unique 14-digit number issued based on the Aadhaar/Aadhaar Enrolment ID (EID) and is applicable for the entire academic career of the student.

facts.fact: After submitting the Basic Information, go to the Apply Fresh menu, read the guidelines and accept the terms
facts.quote: After submitting the Basic Information go to the Apply Fresh menu. Carefully read the guidelines and accept the terms by clicking on the checkboxes and click on continue.

facts.fact: In the application form, select the scheme from the list shown, upload the required documents and click Final Submit
facts.quote: Select the desired scheme from the list, upload required documents and click on Final Submit.

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish; explains that a first-time applicant must first do One Time Registration (OTR) and then log in and fill the scholarship application on scholarships.gov.in (NSP), citing NSP.
fail_if: Says the student can apply without OTR; gives steps from a third-party site instead of NSP.
summary: Added the OTR-first and application steps from NSP's Students page and application FAQ.
